acceptance_criteria.text: Only opt-in loopback local-test mode exposes simulated trade-update injection and inspection.
Valid synthetic provider-shaped trade updates normalize to bounded application-owned event observations stamped with controllable local receive time.
Malformed or over-limit updates are rejected atomically; reset clears update observations; expected-state comparison can inspect them.
Trade-update event hints do not mutate canonical account positions or open orders, and every response identifies simulated PAPER mode.
